title: “M. Polcanov” Memorial 2024: a look back
body_html:
Let’s step back into the atmosphere of the final stage of the tournament recently held at the TOP Cup Academy Arena in memory of Mihail Polcanov, and relive the most remarkable moments of this special sporting event.

For the third year running, European table tennis champion Sofia Polcanova, with the contribution and involvement of TOP CUP Academy, which she founded, is organising under the auspices of ATTP a memorial table tennis tournament for amateurs of the sport, in memory of her late father and coach, Mihail Polcanov.

Every tournament under the auspices of ATTP is a mix of events, stories and heroes. Here the glory of victory meets the disappointment of defeat. Here you will see only meaningful moments and sincere emotions, sometimes with a touch of nostalgia — and, most importantly, honest and well-meaning people!
